original_practice_evidence.all_cleared: Q3 139/139 sources in 10/10 runs; Q4 138/138 sources in 10/10 runs

original_practice_evidence.data_preservation: Input SHA-256 map binds all 60 original sanitized files and manifest. No raw trace bytes were changed.
original_practice_evidence.runtime_boundary: manifest timestamp_delta_s is not interpreted as program runtime; controller clock and HTTP enter-to-exit timestamp difference are separate fields.

resolved_findings: Reject finite-but-unrepresentable negative-disk geometry before constructing Q: finite 16*scale^2 guard; 1e308 regression rejects cleanly.

Negative geometry uses the robust orientation predicate and does not discard small positive hull turns; Q3 true-source containment checked in 3000 updates including the 1000m boundary and degenerate domains.
One premeasure is explicitly outside the inherited six-probe budget. Field finite-bound proof increases total measurement bound from1212 to1228; no virtual-time sleep is introduced.

Clear approach falls back to the original certified point if the discriminant is negative or the final vertex check fails. 200 regions were checked for complete vertex coverage and nonincreasing access distance.
Route portfolio retains the original full-route control and keeps all tasks. Verification includes70 random cases through n=51 and9 exact two-task cases; no global-optimality claim.
Official parser validates request identity, response path, same-ID response consistency, serial transport errors, accepted-record ordering and action/event allowlists.
Observed and manifest virtual time, T/K, source/type counts, cleared channels and certificate flags are cross-checked against accepted responses and post-exit labels.
Official movement and phase time are accumulated in microseconds. Field cost tables recover the charged movement component from the independently checked total and exact integer operation costs.
Local summary failure metric is explicitly mean_failed_clear_attempts_per_case, not a failure rate. Published field tables express failed-clear cost in seconds per source.
Historical refined and its10700-run experiment remain unchanged controls; exploratory parameter changes and guessed-world replay claims were removed.
